title: folio-mapper v1.1 — Regulatory Exemplars & Demo Payloads (Phases 5–6)
description: Selection, authoring, and demo-curation of 4 net-new regulatory/compliance exemplars, chosen by a deterministic FOLIO coverage probe and hardened by two independent subagent critiques. Every leaf resolves to a precise, unique FOLIO concept (100% hit rate) with no taxonomy circularity; every exemplar ships a zero-runtime-cost cached demo payload.
rubric_version: Phase-4 demo-quality pattern (D-01..D-04) + ROADMAP Phase 5/6 success criteria
spend: ≈$0.50 metered — final Gemini 3 Flash curation of 4 demos (≈72 judged items, matching the existing 10-demo standard); iteration passes ran free on the Claude Max proxy; FOLIO probes are deterministic folio-python (near-zero cost).
environment: Local: backend 58001 + embedding index (MiniLM, 18,324 concepts); LLM judge via Gemini (final) / Claude Max proxy (iteration)

sections.title: Deterministic density survey & area selection
sections.body:
FOLIO's Area-of-Law tree has 174 direct children. A deterministic folio-python survey (scripts/demos/regulatory_density_survey.py) ranked candidate regulatory areas by three signals: branch density (recursive descendants), definition coverage, and a 10-leaf exact-hit feasibility check. The exact-hit count is the hard gate — an area that cannot field 10 precise, unique FOLIO leaf labels is DROPPED rather than forced to 'best-available' matches.

SELECTED (all 10/10 exact leaves, 100% definition coverage): Environmental Compliance (branch density 12 — FOLIO's densest regulatory branch), Securities Regulation (10), Energy & Utilities (7), Data Privacy & Cybersecurity (distributed across Information Security / Privacy / Consumer / Government-access branches).

Balanced density AND diversity: four distinct regulatory domains — natural resources, financial-markets regulation, energy/utilities, and tech/data — minimizing overlap with the litigation- and transaction-heavy v1.0 set.

sections.title: Documented exclusions — the probe gate working
sections.body:
Two plausible candidates were probed and DROPPED for thin FOLIO leaf coverage — evidence the gate is real, not decorative:

Tax & Revenue — 5/10 exact leaves. FOLIO's tax branch is leaf-thin: only Tax Law, Tax Credits Law, Estates/Gifts/Trusts, Non-Profit/Tax-Exempt, and ESOP resolve precisely. Income/Property/Sales/International/Corporate Tax have no precise FOLIO node (they fuzzy-match to broad parents).

Healthcare / health-privacy — 3/10 exact leaves, branch density 0. Health Law, Food and Drug Law, and Public Health & Welfare Law are leaf-terminal; Medicare/Medicaid/Pharmaceutical/Mental-Health/Elder/Nursing-Home have no precise node. This is exactly the mission's 'plausible candidate' that the deterministic probe correctly gates out.

sections.title: Exemplar — Environmental Compliance (STRONG)
sections.body:
Persona: environmental / EHS / natural-resources counsel and ESG leads. Ten leaves span air & water quality, contamination & cleanup, chemicals & resources, water & wildlife, and ESG/impact review — tracking how an environmental lawyer actually carves the domain (Clean Air/Water Act, CERCLA/RCRA, TSCA, wetlands/minerals, ESG). Densest, cleanest all-Area-of-Law taxonomy in the batch; zero overlap with existing cards.

Critique fix applied: Chemical Safety Law was moved out of a mis-named 'Corporate Sustainability' branch (it is a toxics/contamination area, not governance); ESG is now paired with Impact Assessment Law under 'Sustainability & Review'.

sections.title: Exemplar — Energy & Utilities (revised WEAK→ADEQUATE)
sections.body:
Persona: energy regulatory / utilities / project-development counsel (FERC, renewables, nuclear). Real and new to the portfolio. FOLIO's pure Energy-Law branch is thin (6 non-circular AoL leaves), so the exemplar supplements with energy-SPECIFIC FOLIO concepts from adjacent branches.

Critique fixes applied: (1) removed the circular leaf 'Renewable Energy Law' — it is the FOLIO PARENT of Solar/Wind/Hydro, which are themselves leaves; listing a parent beside its own children is a taxonomy error the hardened gate now blocks. (2) Dropped the engineering-jargon 'Baseload Power' branch and regrouped hydro. (3) Swapped the ancestor 'Utilities Industry' out of the leaves for 'Project Finance Law' (Area of Law). Final: 7 Area-of-Law + 3 energy-specific concepts (Oil and Gas Extraction Industry, Nuclear/Fossil Electric Power Generation), zero circularity.

Known residual (disclosed): 3 leaves are FOLIO Industry/generation concepts rather than pure Areas of Law. This is an accepted compromise — FOLIO's most precise energy concepts live in those branches, and existing v1.0 exemplars likewise mix concept types (immigration uses visa/status concepts; banking-finance uses financial instruments).
sections.output_sample: Solar Energy Law · Wind Power Law · Hydroelectric Energy Law · Nuclear Law · Oil and Gas Law · Oil and Gas Extraction Industry · Nuclear Electric Power Generation · Fossil Fuel Electric Power Generation · Energy Sales and Transmission Law · Project Finance Law

rubric_scores.note: 10/10 exact, no circularity; 3 Industry concepts disclosed

sections.title: Exemplar — Securities Enforcement (revised for distinctiveness)
sections.body:
Persona: SEC/FINRA regulatory & enforcement counsel; adviser/broker-dealer compliance. FOLIO concentrates securities concepts inside the branch that Banking & Finance and Corporate M&A already draw from, so the first draft overlapped those cards on 7 of 10 leaves (4 with banking-finance) — reading as a near-duplicate on the carousel.

Critique fix applied: reframed from deal-work to enforcement/regulation and retitled the card 'Securities Enforcement'. Leaf overlap with banking-finance cut from 4 to 0; the card now leads with Investment Advisor Law, Exchanges Law, Commodities Law, Regulatory Enforcement, Financial Reporting Law, Business & Financial Crimes Law, and Anti-Corruption Law (FCPA), plus the enforcement-defining Securities Fraud / Insider Trading. Residual overlap: 3 leaves shared with Corporate M&A / Commercial Litigation (Securities Fraud, Insider Trading, Security Offerings) — appropriate, since those ARE securities-enforcement concepts.

A PM question is queued: keep this reframed card, or swap it for a fully-distinct area (e.g. International Trade & Sanctions, pending its own density probe).

sections.title: Exemplar — Data Privacy & Cybersecurity (revised WEAK→STRONG)
sections.body:
Persona: privacy & cybersecurity counsel / CPO / DPO (GDPR/CCPA compliance, breach response, surveillance/government access). Fastest-growing, highest-demand area in the batch; zero overlap with any v1.0 card — the clearest audience expansion.

Critique fixes applied: dropped three defective leaves — Information Security Law (was BOTH the declared root branch AND a leaf: circular + near-duplicate of Cybersecurity Law), Right to Privacy (a Civil Right, cross-taxonomy and duplicative of Privacy Law), and Records Management (a Business-of-Law operations concept). Replaced with Consumer Protection Law, Telecommunications Law, and Freedom of Information Act Claim. Data Protection Regulation (FOLIO's single best GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA concept) is retained.

sections.title: Subagent critique — ontology precision (FOLIO MCP)
sections.body:
An independent subagent verified leaf placement against FOLIO via MCP (get_concept / get_parents). Root-cause finding it surfaced: the initial gate checked only that each leaf resolves to one exact label — never that the concept sits under its claimed branch, is an Area of Law (vs. Industry / Civil Rights / Business of Law), or is non-circular with its co-leaves. That is why cross-taxonomy and parent/child picks passed as '100% exact'.

Verdicts (first draft): environmental STRONG; securities ADEQUATE-precision; energy WEAK (3 Industry leaves + Renewable-Energy-Law circularity + hydro mis-group); data-privacy WEAK (Information Security Law root-as-leaf, Right to Privacy = Civil Right, Records Management = Business of Law).

Highest-value recommendation — ADOPTED: add a branch-membership / anti-circularity assertion to the gate. validate_exemplar_hits.py now fails if any leaf is an ancestor of a co-leaf; this check caught the energy circularity during the revision pass. All flagged leaves were fixed (see sections 4–6).
sections.context: Ontology-precision critique of the 4 regulatory exemplars, verified via FOLIO MCP.

sections.title: Subagent critique — product / persona
sections.body:
A second independent subagent reviewed persona value, labels, structure, and portfolio fit. Ranking by product value: (1) Data Privacy & Cybersecurity — highest demand, zero overlap; (2) Environmental Compliance — clean distinct practice; (3) Energy & Utilities — valuable persona, weakest structure; (4) Securities — real persona undercut by ~70% leaf redundancy in the first draft.

Recommendation: ship 3 clean, revise the 4th (securities) — either retitle+de-duplicate (adopted) or swap for International Trade & Sanctions (queued as a PM question). Also flagged awkward branch names ('Baseload Power', 'Government & Identity') — all renamed. Suggested label trims — applied (securities retitled 'Securities Enforcement'; descriptions de-duplicated).
sections.context: Product/persona critique of the 4 regulatory exemplars.

sections.title: Demo payloads — curation results
sections.body: Each exemplar was curated into a cached demo payload via curate_demos.py driving the full live pipeline (embedding index + spaCy + keyword + Stage-3 LLM judge), threshold 0.3 / accept-threshold 0.9. Provider decision: after Phase 4, all 10 existing demos were re-curated via Gemini (commit 5f64e41) and the smoke test pins provider=google / model=gemini-3-flash-preview — the 4 new demos follow the same standard so the 14-demo set stays consistent. Iteration passes ran free through the Claude Max proxy; the final pass used the metered Gemini key (cheapest tier). Unlike Phase 4's thin litigation areas, these regulatory branches fan out richly — every item offers a deep candidate set with strong judge activity, so no D-02 coherence override was needed. Final per-area metrics are in the output sample.

sections.title: Quality gates — 100% hit rate + anti-circularity + zero-cost demos
sections.body: All 40 leaves pass scripts/demos/validate_exemplar_hits.py: exact unique get_by_label, top search_by_label at score 100, and no leaf is an ancestor of a co-leaf. The full web test suite covers all 14 demo areas across 6 harnesses (roundtrip, no-network, richness, excluded-branches, smoke, manifest). Demo mode makes zero runtime network calls (deterministic cached payloads).

Checked 40 leaves across 4 exemplars.
PASS: every leaf resolves to a precise, unique FOLIO concept (100% hit rate).

sections.title: In-app browser verification (isolated context)
sections.body: Each of the 4 regulatory demos was loaded in the real app (Vite dev @58173) via the Demo toggle in an isolated browser context. All 4 cards render in the carousel with the DEMO badge; clicking each loads the full mapping screen from the cached payload (item 1 of 18, 72–83% progress, scored multi-branch candidates, suggestion/review queues). Network panel confirms zero /api/pipeline or LLM calls — the first load even rendered fully while the backend was OFFLINE (all /api status polls returned 500), the strongest possible proof of the zero-cost cached path. Round-trip/no-network/richness/excluded-branches/smoke/manifest test harnesses all cover the 4 new slugs: 166/166 tests green.
